name: Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme (CSIS)
description: Scheme to provide full interest subsidy during the moratorium period on modern educational loans taken by students from economically weaker sections.
benefits: 100% interest subsidy during the course period plus one year
Applicable for technical and professional higher education courses in India
Administered through Canara Bank nodal portal
eligibility: Gross family annual income ceiling of Rs. 4.5 lakh
Enrolled in recognized professional/technical courses in India
requiredDocuments: Income Certificate issued by competent authority
Loan Sanction Letter from scheduled commercial bank
applicationProcess: Apply through the Vidya Lakshmi portal or National Scholarship Portal
Submit bank loan account details and EWS certificate
Verification and direct interest credit by nodal bank
source: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education

name: PM Poshan Shakti Nirman (Mid-Day Meal CSS)
description: Centrally Sponsored Scheme providing one hot cooked nutritious meal per day to children in primary and upper primary classes across participating government schools.
benefits: Free balanced daily hot cooked meal covering prescribed calories and protein
Encourages school enrollment, attendance, and nutritional retention
Cost-shared between Central government and State/UT administrations
eligibility: Children studying in classes I to VIII in Government and Government-aided schools
Enrolled in local body schools, Special Training Centres, and Madarsas
requiredDocuments: Aadhaar identification of student or parent
applicationProcess: Automatic enrollment upon admission to any eligible government or government-aided school
No separate individual application fee or paperwork required
source: Ministry of Education, Government of India

name: Telangana Rythu Bandhu Scheme
description: State welfare initiative providing direct financial investment support of Rs. 10,000 per acre per year to farmer patta holders to purchase agricultural inputs.
benefits: Direct benefit transfer of Rs. 5,000 per acre per agricultural season (Kharif and Rabi)
Total Rs. 10,000 per acre per year for agriculture and horticulture crops
Zero interest grant to prevent indebtedness to private moneylenders
eligibility: Resident landholding farmer of Telangana with title passbook (Pattadar)
Land must be cultivated agriculture or horticulture land
applicationProcess: Check name and land details in Dharani agricultural land records
Submit bank account details to local Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO)
Direct benefit transferred directly to verified bank account
source: Department of Agriculture, Government of Telangana

name: Chandigarh UT Pension for Widows and Destitute Women
description: Union Territory social welfare program providing monthly pension of Rs. 2,000 to widows and destitute women residing in Chandigarh.
benefits: Monthly financial assistance of Rs. 2,000 credited directly to DBT account
Financial security for vulnerable and destitute women without earning support
eligibility: Widow or destitute woman who is a permanent resident of Chandigarh for at least 3 years
Family annual income should not exceed Rs. 1,50,000
Not receiving any other government pension or financial assistance
requiredDocuments: Chandigarh 3-year residence proof (Voter ID, Ration card, Electricity bill)
Income certificate issued by Sub-Divisional Magistrate
Aadhaar card and active bank account passbook
applicationProcess: Download application form from official social welfare department portal
Submit completed form with certificates to the District Social Welfare Officer
Physical verification and approval by sanctioning committee
source: Department of Social Welfare, Chandigarh Administration
